explanation: The value is nonzero only at the GO step, and only late in the episode (about trial 74 onward) when the agent chooses a1 right after a rewarded trial that was also part of a run of rewarded a1 choices. In that case it is about 10 once the run is 2 or more rewarded a1 trials long, and around 1-5 on the first one or two rewarded a1 trials after a loss. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at every a2 choice, on any GO right after an unrewarded trial, and at all steps before about trial 70, even during long rewarded a1 runs.
